title: curated.yaml
description: Curation metadata for one agent entry (agents/<id>/curated.yaml). Not part of the ACP registry schema and never merged into dist/registry.json. To add a new field, extend this schema first — scripts/build.py rejects unknown keys.

tier.description: 1 = core (major vendor or high adoption), 2 = watchlist (meets criteria but less proven)

status.description: stale entries are candidates for removal per CRITERIA.md

added.description: Date the agent was admitted, YYYY-MM-DD

health.description: requires-auth = the agent needs an interactive login before answering the ACP handshake; scripts/health_check.py skips it

version_source_url.description: Page to fetch when the agent has no npm/PyPI/GitHub Releases source; must be paired with version_source_pattern

version_source_pattern.description: Regex applied to version_source_url's body; the first capture group is the upstream version
